alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were reduced with 0.1 M of dithiothreitol (DTT) and alkylated with 50 mM iodacetamide (IAA) before being digested in a filter unit according to the filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) procedure, adding trypsin to 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate in a 1:50 ratio.

instrument.evidence: LC–MS/MS runs were carried out with a Q Exactive HF Orbitrap mass spectrometer coupled to an Ultimate 3000 Rapid Separation liquid chromatography (LC) system.

labeling.evidence: Quantitative proteomics of the AML patients and CD34+ cells was performed according to the label-free quantification (LFQ) approach.
